determinations.detail: the exported manifest carries no provenance metadata, so a reader cannot distinguish shipped registry state from a branch export

determinations.subject: serving stack
determinations.detail: the runtime reports no serving_stack or engine_module; a flag here would reintroduce the operator memory this milestone exists to remove

determinations.subject: environment.cpu_physical_cores
determinations.detail: physical core count needs a dependency the runtime deliberately does not carry; logical threads are reported instead and are not a substitute

determinations.subject: environment.ram_total_mib
determinations.detail: total memory is POSIX-only through the standard library; the Windows path would need a pointer cast that has already produced one silent zero here

determinations.subject: environment.thread_env
determinations.detail: no thread-pool variable is set in the runtime's environment, so the engine libraries defaulted internally - which is not the same as one thread

determinations.subject: environment.hardware_class
determinations.detail: the reference machine has not been ratified, so no era label is recorded; performance comparability across machines stays ungated

determinations.subject: package qwen3-asr
